q: The HR Business Partner (HRBP) Manager serves as the strategic people partner to the Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Warehousing, Logistics, and related support functions in Kuwait. The role is responsible for aligning people strategies with business objectives while ensuring operational excellence across a predominantly blue-collar workforce. The HRBP Manager drives workforce planning, employee engagement, talent development, organizational effectiveness, employee relations, and compliance with Kuwait labor laws and company policies.
8–12 years of progressive HR experience, including significant exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, FMCG, or industrial environments.
Demonstrated experience managing large blue-collar and multi-national workforces.
Strong knowledge of Kuwait Labor Law and HR best practices.
Experience in employee relations, workforce planning, talent management, and organizational development.
Strong business acumen with the ability to influence and build credibility with senior leaders.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in HR systems and workforce analytics.
r: Partner with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to develop and execute people strategies that support business growth, productivity, and operational excellence.
Provide proactive HR advice and coaching to managers on organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, and employee engagement.
Analyze workforce trends and HR metrics to identify opportunities and risks and recommend actionable solutions.
Lead and manage employee relations matters, including disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, conflict resolution, and performance concerns.
Foster a positive employee relations climate across factories, warehouses, and distribution operations.
Ensure fair and consistent application of company policies and labor law requirements.
Drive talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and capability-building initiatives.
Support recruitment and onboarding activities for both management and frontline operational roles.
Partner with leaders to identify critical talent gaps and implement development plans.
Lead employee engagement initiatives to strengthen morale, retention, productivity, and organizational culture.
Act as a champion of Americana’s values, ensuring consistent communication and employee involvement across all levels of the organization.
Support change management initiatives arising from business transformation, restructuring, or operational improvements.
Facilitate the performance management process, including goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and development planning.
Coach managers on effective performance conversations and performance improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with Kuwait labor law, company policies, collective agreements (where applicable), and internal governance requirements.
Support compensation, benefits, employee lifecycle activities, and workforce administration in partnership with HR Shared Services and Centers of Excellence.
Monitor and improve HR processes to enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.

d: Asico is a Dubai-based real estate company focused on property brokerage, recruitment, and related property management operations. Working at the intersection of talent and property, the company supports continued business growth by connecting the right professionals with the right opportunities across the real estate market.

This role is a strong fit for someone who understands the pace and expectations of real estate hiring and is also well versed in HR Executive Operations . You will play an important part in helping the business build high-quality teams by identifying talent that aligns with the needs of a growing real estate operation.
q: Minimum 1 - 3 years experience in Real Estate Recruitment and HR Operations .
Experience in identifying, attracting and engaging experienced real estate agents.
Clear understanding of the UAE real estate market.
Fluent English is mandatory; knowledge of Arabic and any other language is a plus.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and recruitment databases or ATS systems.
Experience using recruitment platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt, Naukrigulf, or similar platforms.
Experience recruiting real estate agents and sales professionals is preferable
r: Operate the day to day HR administration functions .
Source qualified real estate professionals for open opportunities.
Screen and interview candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Attract high-performing real estate talent, including real estate agents and sales professionals.
Support the company’s ongoing growth and workforce requirements through effective hiring activity.
x: Monthly Compensation + Incentives on Recruitment of Real Estate Agents
A dynamic and collaborative work environment with growth potential.
